witnesses.name: Met Office Central England Temperature (HadCET)
witnesses.note: Confirmed: Met Office Central England Temperature (HadCET), an independent record, also shows a real rising trend.

witnesses.name: ERA5 (ECMWF reanalysis, via Open-Meteo)
witnesses.independence: Different centre and model, but shares many observations with MERRA-2: supporting, not fully independent
witnesses.note: Consistent: ERA5 (ECMWF reanalysis, via Open-Meteo) also shows a real rising trend. It shares some input data with NASA's record, so this is a consistency check, not independent proof.

witnesses.name: Weather station NOTTINGHAM WATNALL, UK (65 km away)
witnesses.independence: Independent: a real thermometer / rain gauge (NOAA GHCN), but one spot, not a ~50 km area
witnesses.witness_units_note: Station values describe one spot; compare direction and verdict.
witnesses.note: Confirmed: Weather station NOTTINGHAM WATNALL, UK (65 km away), an independent record, also shows a real rising trend.
